verdict_note: Strong GTM and operations foundation with EdTech P&L scale, but lacks direct RevOps, forecasting, and enterprise sales systems depth that OpenAI values.

breakdown.note: AGM + Senior PM titles signal Manager level; P&L ownership across 5 markets demonstrates commercial accountability. Role expects 6+ years Strategy & Ops—candidate has 8+ GTM/BD, but not pure ops/RevOps background.

Strong on GTM strategy, KPI dashboards, funnel analytics, cross-functional leadership, CRM (Salesforce). Missing direct experience with forecasting, pipeline management, revenue operations, business reviews, and operating cadences at enterprise scale.

EdTech D2C and international pipeline experience transfer well to enterprise GTM motion. No direct enterprise SaaS sales support or B2B2C systems experience. AI/GEO research is distinctive but not directly relevant to this ops role.

Quantified wins (38% CAC lift, 19% ARR growth, 42% enablement uplift) and cross-functional orchestration (60+ person teams) are strong. Forecasting, pipeline health, and enterprise business reviews less visible in narrative.

Requires H1B sponsorship; OpenAI (well-funded, tier-1) is capable, but visa dependency is a secondary penalty. Based in US on OPT now, MBA completion May 2027 adds timeline uncertainty for extended visa processing.

top_signal: P&L ownership across 5 city markets with measurable operational improvements (20% productivity lift, 25% sales growth); demonstrated ability to build scalable KPI systems and dashboards used by senior leadership—directly mirrors role's need for reporting frameworks and operating cadences.
biggest_gap: No explicit RevOps, forecasting, or enterprise sales rhythms background. Role expects deep experience with pipeline reviews, territory models, and Sales operating cadences. Candidate's strength is GTM strategy and D2C funnel, not the systems/ops infrastructure that powers enterprise sales execution. MBA completion timeline (May 2027) may also complicate H1B sponsorship timing if role needs immediate visa clarity.
